purpose_context: The slide-deck feature shipped but the deployed example decks render with broken CSS, misplaced metadata, and a malfunctioning footer, and any diagram authored beyond the first slide mis-renders. This mission remediates those defects so the hosted decks are presentable and usable, and adds brief on-page guidance so readers know how to navigate and export them.
purpose_tldr: Fix the reveal.js slide-deck rendering defects on the docsite and make deck diagrams render on every slide, not just the first.
